That makes sense. I was treating PENDING as safe to retry, but you're right that it doesn't tell me whether the provider call never happened or succeeded just before the crash.    Using a deterministic identifier/tag derived from the idempotency key gives me a way to recover the ambiguous case without relying on provider-side idempotency.    I hadn't considered recovering PENDING through lookup/adoption rather than immediately retrying the create request. Thanks, this addresses the failure window I was mainly concerned about.
